summary_hint: Proof that <boarder> has resided at <residence address> since <residency start>, evidenced by a <evidence type> from <evidence provider> dated <document date>.

typed_core.name: issuer_name
typed_core.why: identity — who produced the proof (utility, agency, employer); source independence

typed_core.name: document_title
typed_core.why: disambiguator — classification aid; distinguishes a utility bill vs an affidavit

typed_core.name: boarder_name
typed_core.why: identity — whose residency this proves (flattened from person)

typed_core.name: borrower_or_host_name
typed_core.why: identity — attributes the boarder to the borrower/host (flattened from person)

typed_core.name: relationship_to_borrower
typed_core.why: processor — boarder-income eligibility hinges on the relationship

typed_core.name: residence_address
typed_core.why: identity — which property the boarder lives in; must match subject (flattened from address)
typed_core.prompt_hint: Prefer the residence address that matches the subject property.

typed_core.name: unit_or_room_description
typed_core.why: disambiguator — a shared dwelling; identifies the specific room/unit

typed_core.name: evidence_type
typed_core.why: identity — what kind of proof this is (degraded from enum; no enum coercer)

typed_core.name: evidence_issuer_or_provider
typed_core.why: identity/source — the third party attesting residency

typed_core.name: document_date
typed_core.why: processor — recency of the evidence

typed_core.name: coverage_or_service_period_start
typed_core.why: processor — the period the evidence covers (flattened from date_range)

typed_core.name: coverage_or_service_period_end
typed_core.why: processor — period end (flattened from date_range)

typed_core.name: account_or_reference_number_masked
typed_core.why: PII (restricted, pre-masked) — must be typed to avoid unmasked catch-all

typed_core.name: residency_start_date
typed_core.why: processor — establishes length of shared residency

typed_core.name: current_residency_indicator
typed_core.why: processor — whether the boarder still resides there (degraded from boolean)
typed_core.prompt_hint: A yes/no attestation; capture the underlying phrase in the snippet since it degrades to a string.

typed_core.name: mailing_and_service_address
typed_core.why: disambiguator — a mailing address differing from the residence address weakens the proof (flattened from object)

typed_core.name: occupancy_attestation
typed_core.why: processor — the attestation language a reviewer reads

typed_core.name: property_address
typed_core.why: identity/linkage — link to subject or non-subject property (flattened from address)

typed_core.name: loan_number
typed_core.why: linkage — attaches document to the loan file (confidential identifier)

typed_core.name: account_case_reference_number
typed_core.why: identity — cross-document matching/dedup

nested_lists.name: supporting_documents
nested_lists.shape_reason: it genuinely repeats and each item is a single label needing no per-field wrapping (bare string per item)

fields.name: document_name
fields.why: processor review of what backs the proof — a single attachment label per item

rejected.name: party_names / party_addresses
rejected.reason: generic; superseded by typed boarder_name, borrower_or_host_name, residence_address

rejected.name: document_status_or_version
rejected.reason: no consumer for this evidence type

rejected.name: signature_blocks, notary_block, boarder_signature_and_date, borrower_or_host_signature_and_date, third_party_verifier_contact
rejected.reason: execution detail with no rule; not required to be executed

encoding_variations: Proof of residency arrives many ways: a utility bill, a bank statement, a government letter, a lease, or a signed affidavit. evidence_type + evidence_issuer_or_provider together disambiguate which — an amount or date alone is meaningless without the evidence type beside it.
Residency start may be stated as an explicit 'resident since' date or implied by a coverage/service period; keep both residency_start_date and the coverage period so a reviewer can reconcile.

open_questions.q: supporting_documents shape — flat-row nested list of strings vs flatten to a single joined string in typed_core?
options: flatten to a single joined string in typed_core
open_questions.recommendation: flat-row list, but acceptable to flatten if plumbing cost outweighs the value given zero rules GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): BUILD IT — LP-437 made nested lists cheap (one declaration + the generic mechanism); the one-list-budget / defer / no-consumer concern is overturned. Build as flat_row; the per-rule consumer is separate follow-up.

open_questions.q: Which address is authoritative — residence_address vs property_address vs mailing_and_service_address may all appear?
open_questions.recommendation: keep all three typed; let a future rule reconcile against the subject property rather than collapsing here

open_questions.q: PII scope for home addresses — should a boarder's residence_address be registered/masked?
open_questions.recommendation: flag for the domain expert; standard sensitivity in the catalog suggests no, but it is a private residence GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): mask account-like identifiers (policy/account/plan numbers, wire/ACH trace, check references) via _PII_FIELDS; leave addresses and public-record case numbers PLAIN; DOB is unmasked (pii null).

notes: No rules read this document today (rule_count 0), so there is no rule floor; every field earns its place on identity, PII protection, or processor review.
Prompt hint (doc-level): this is a boarder-income supporting document — the goal is to prove the boarder shares the borrower's residence.
Prompt hint (doc-level): do not infer a residency conclusion — capture the stated dates and attestation verbatim.

PII flagged for review: loan_number is a confidential identifier (flag whether it warrants _PII_FIELDS registration); residence_address / mailing_and_service_address are a private individual's home address, standard sensitivity in the catalog but arguably PII — flag for review. account_or_reference_number_masked (pre_masked true) needs _PII_FIELDS registration and is not in the 7-field registry today.
Ambiguity: loan_number's why is 'linkage', not one of the five reason classes; classified as identity (attaches/cross-references the loan file).
